economic_thesis: Gradual capital rotation creates persistent cross-sectional repricing after the common BTC move is removed. A path-efficient medium-horizon residual drift should continue over the next daily holding interval, while subtracting recent actual funding pressure avoids the expensive crowded side and reduces squeeze risk. A small causal BTC-trend tilt assigns more gross to longs in broad advances and shorts in broad declines without eliminating either sleeve.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Negative residual laggards and a bounded negative BTC tilt should make short attribution positive; the smaller long sleeve holds relative survivors.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Positive residual leaders and a bounded positive BTC tilt should make long attribution positive; the smaller short sleeve targets laggards rather than broad beta.
expected_regime_roles.chop: A near-neutral BTC tilt leaves a balanced dispersion book intended to earn from continuation between relative winners and losers, so combined chop return should be positive.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Own path-efficient positive BTC-residual drift while penalizing recently expensive positive funding; it must remain materially active and contribute positively in bull.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short path-efficient negative BTC-residual drift while favoring recently positive funding receipts; it must remain materially active and contribute positively in bear.
expected_regime_roles.stress: BTC residualization and funding de-crowding limit common-beta and squeeze exposure; past-volatility scaling and boundary drawdown brakes aim to keep stress near flat and cap tails, with no promise of positive stress return.

falsifier: Reject the family before risk selection if none of the 12 preregistered H x K x path-exponent core cells has positive no-control aggregate net Sharpe, positive no-control net return in at least four of six chronological folds, positive pooled next-day score information coefficient, and positive score information coefficient in at least four folds. Risk overlays cannot rescue that failure. Also reject or formally pivot if the otherwise identical raw-momentum ablation has a higher declared selection metric than the selected BTC-residual signal; residualization cannot be silently removed.
mechanism: At each 00:00 UTC boundary, use only closed 8h bars and funding rows strictly before the decision. Estimate each eligible contract's 30-day past-only beta to BTC, accumulate its standardized residual drift over 14, 21, or 28 days excluding the latest 1 or 3 days, and multiply by signed path efficiency. Robust-z the current cross-section and subtract 0.35 times robust-z of actual seven-day funding. Long the positive top tail and short the negative bottom tail with capped inverse-residual-volatility weights. Keep gross 0.80 and tilt sleeve gross by at most 0.10 using a clipped past 60-day BTC return, so net stays within 0.20 and both sleeves remain live. Hold between daily rebalances; never impute missing history or substitute a one-sided book.
risk_policy_plan: First require the no-control core to pass the preregistered causal falsifier. Then register no control, 30-day 35% volatility target only (scale 0.25 to 1.00), drawdown brakes only (gross 0.75 at 10%, 0.40 at 18%, flat at 25%), and the combined policy, each at base and doubled costs. Position/time stops, turnover limit, and side scaling stay disabled; same-boundary reentry is false. Retain a control only if it improves its stated drawdown or 1% expected-shortfall failure mode without breaking any mandatory regime, sleeve, cost, or aggregate gate.
selection_metric: Across six separate chronological cutoff-safe fold replays, first require every frozen development, regime, sleeve, concentration, multiplicity, doubled-cost, and declared parameter-neighborhood gate. Among passers maximize J = 25th percentile of the six net fold Sharpes + 0.25 times doubled-cost OOF Sharpe. Tie-break by lower maximum drawdown, then lower annualized one-way turnover, then lexicographically smallest canonical parameter JSON. No passer means no champion.
